# Cogstrata

> Cogstrata is a third-party data augmentation platform. It enriches first-party customer data with 5,000+ external signals — demographics, economics, environment — at neighbourhood level, continuously recalibrated against live macro signals and structured for both human analysts and AI agents.

Key facts:
- Coverage: neighbourhood-level micro-areas (postcode / ZIP / district), aggregated with no individual PII
- Attributes: 500+ base attributes expanding to 5,000+ derived datapoints per record
- Classification: 24 groups, each with a three-part plain-English label (Economic Position · Household Profile · Setting), trait tags, and a pre-written AI summary for agent context windows
- Refresh: continuous recalibration against live signals (central-bank rates, inflation, employment, energy prices, house-price indices)
- Delivery: REST API, batch export, cloud data marketplaces (rolling out)
- Compliance: GDPR-compliant, aligned with regional privacy frameworks; no personal data held
- Evaluation: free 24-hour sample run on your own file, no contract
